## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6c0f3f2fca6ec3419b514cb7975f818e282669f3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md + none
Security-touching: yes

PR #37518, card #37514 of epic #37424: the follow-up to contract record 7188270415 on PR #37470. One file, +9/−8, text only, merge base `0b1411d4`. Read: the card's body and its three comments (claim 7188999386, dev report 7189242446, triage), the PR body and the area's final-head comment 7189535910, the net diff, ruling records 7184753035, 7185703578 and 7187264388, the epic's body, and the 49 check-runs on the head (26 success, 23 skipped, none failed). ADR-0150 D3 and the registry were read in the tree at the head; nothing was built or run.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant. The one substantive hunk adds a clause to the part that teaches how the "move into a package" door judges a write — the selection judged as a set under ADR-0150 D3 (a), the rule that decides whether a package caller may resolve an environment-authored item. The card itself calls it a security-related rule. It adds a sentence and no mechanism; there is no security finding.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set and public surface: none.** No schema, code, test or generated file. Right.
- **The pinned table.** The 32 rows `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` matches are byte-identical between `origin/main` and the head, and the diff adds no line of that row shape. The UI test lanes were skipped on this head, so the pin holds by construction and by the dev's local 12/12, not by a check-run.
- **ADR gates.** `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Check Documentation Links` are green. By construction: the two new links both target `#amendment-2026-11-26-moves`, defined once; the diff adds no symbol anchor and no `path:NNN` line anchor; `Refs:` gains "D3" on an ADR-0150 link that already resolved. The title is unchanged, so the `docs/adr/README.md` row is unchanged.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `docs/adr/**` is not published. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right: nothing in the diff moves an accept-set.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags.** Report 7189242446 carries `open_questions: []`. Its two `out_of_scope_findings` are answered: the `pm:blocked` label taken off with the claim is a process deviation for the area, not a contract matter; the note that the N3 line sits in the security-touching part is confirmed, and is why this record reads `yes`.
- **Nothing is escalated.** No edited sentence puts a question to the maintainer or decides one.
- **SQL push-down.** Not applicable: no query in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**The four nits of record 7188270415 this PR claims.**

- N3: closed. Ruling record 7184753035 reads: "runs each item through the save door's judges, judging the selection as a set for the ADR-0150 D3 (a) cross-boundary rule". The text now reads: "runs each through the judges a save runs, judging the selection as a set for the cross-boundary rule of ADR-0150 D3 (a)". Same subject, same verb, same rule, same citation; nothing is added and nothing is left out. ADR-0150 D3 does carry a consequence lettered (a) — a package caller never resolves to an environment-authored item by bare name — so the citation resolves to the rule the ruling means. `Refs:` now lists ADR-0150 D3.
- N4: closed. `form` is "a type not yet registered", and the bullet says "the card that is to register the type". The registry at the head holds no `form` row, so both are now true.
- N5: closed. The "Decided by" list now names "decision 1's line that revises ADR-0146's split" beside decision 9, both under question 1. The epic's decision 1 has that line, and ruling 1 = B (7187264388) is what undoes it.
- N2: closed. All three sentences carry a mark dated 2026-11-26: the 2026-11-24 note at the top; the `datasource` example in that day's "What stands" row; the same example in item 2 of its list. The two `datasource` marks say the same thing the 2026-11-26 Placements part says — the type stays in 平台 Platform and the menu is to draw no row — and link to it.

**Does any edited sentence decide something not ruled?** No. Each of the nine added lines restates a ruling record, the epic's body, or a sentence already in the 2026-11-26 amendment. No new quotation is added. N1 (item 11, the place of `form` inside 常用) is untouched and still flagged as not ruled; N6 and N7 are untouched, as the card says.

**Finding.**

- N8 (nit) — The new mark on the 2026-11-24 top note ends "the note below". The note directly below is the 2026-11-25 one; the 2026-11-26 note is the second below. The mark is dated, so the reader cannot land on the wrong decision, but the two `datasource` marks link their target and this one does not. Leave it, or link it to `#amendment-2026-11-26-position` at the next touch of the file.

**Hand-off.** Tier H by path; the maintainer merges. This record does not lift that. The PR is a draft with labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`.

N2: closed
N3: closed
N4: closed
N5: closed
